requirement_mapping.original_requirement: Exact v24 FORCEKANA command registration and constructor arguments, not expression or method-as-command homonym.
requirement_mapping.current_requirement: Exact v24 FORCEKANA command registration and constructor arguments, not expression or method-as-command homonym.

requirement_mapping.original_requirement: FORCEKANA: actual constructor-selected builder and CreateArgument rejection/nullable/raw rules; never infer legal inputs from minArg alone.
requirement_mapping.current_requirement: FORCEKANA: actual constructor-selected builder and CreateArgument rejection/nullable/raw rules; never infer legal inputs from minArg alone.
requirement_mapping.adjudication: ArgumentBuilder.cs:48-96/120-124,175,909-960: actual INT_EXPRESSION(false), Int64 type, minArg0, checkArgumentType before use; no terms supplies integer0 with warning, not a mandatory-argument rejection. Wrong first type or null first term is rejected; extra arguments warn (level1) and first term is selected, so minArg alone is not a signature. Public display_commands.py:85-89 evaluates its supplied expression without defaulting omission. Prior E56B omitted-argument continuation/rejection is retained as historical parser/control evidence, not recertified as a fresh run. No dynamic FORCEKANA-helper equivalence is inferred from PRINT helper counts.

requirement_mapping.original_requirement: Selected literal conversion modes0..3 and invalid/bounds behavior; source half/fullwidth conversion.
requirement_mapping.current_requirement: Selected literal conversion modes0..3 and invalid/bounds behavior; source half/fullwidth conversion.
requirement_mapping.adjudication: Raw KANALOG01 selected modes0/1/3 agree; mode2 [ああｱ A] vs [あああ A]. KANALOG02 and independently executed six-line KANALITERAL213_STANDALONE retain Native U+FF71 vs public U+3042. Twelve literal conditions have eight matches and four differences. This is observable output-conversion interaction, not independent flag/setter state misassignment or Japanese input behavior.

requirement_mapping.original_requirement: Case213 standalone retains halfwidth Native but public converts mode2; mode3 legacy VU codepoint mismatch.
requirement_mapping.current_requirement: Case213 standalone retains halfwidth Native but public converts mode2; mode3 legacy VU codepoint mismatch.
requirement_mapping.adjudication: K213_1/4/7 mode2: ｱ,ｶﾞ,ｳﾞ remain halfwidth Native, public あ,が,ゔ. K213_8 mode3 ｳﾞ: Native ヴ U+30F4 vs public ゔ U+3094. PARFORCE01 -1: both stop line3 before AFTER; diagnostic presentation differs. Source rejects <0 or >3 before setting flags. Historical E56 positive4/string/omission evidence remains separately scoped.

requirement_mapping.original_requirement: No broad Unicode-normalization demand; document exact strings/codepoints and mode-specific source branch.
requirement_mapping.current_requirement: No broad Unicode-normalization demand; document exact strings/codepoints and mode-specific source branch.
requirement_mapping.adjudication: Native ExpressionMediator.cs:36-42 sets flags,67-80 converts with Japanese LCID0x0411; mode2 Hiragana only, mode3 Hiragana|Wide. Public printing.py mode2 and3 normalize halfwidth runs with NFKC then map kana. PRINTK literals remove helper/FORM dependencies; 212 corroborates output interaction and preserves helper/state observations. No universal Unicode/glyph claim or setter-only attribution.

Japanese input/IME behavior, GUI glyph rendering, full Unicode conversion, all dynamic argument side effects and natural Native exit are not established.
E56 historical missing/type/positive-boundary evidence is retained with its original coverage; no new engine run recertifies it.
